subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_Index2LightID
subjects.behavior: Converts an HSD light-slot ordinal into the corresponding GX light identifier so setup and initialization can address hardware light slots without depending on the GX enum's non-linear encoding; it also supplies the ambient pseudo-ID and invalid-input sentinel.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjAddAnimAll
subjects.behavior: Attaches a positionally corresponding HSD_LightAnim description to every light in a next-linked HSD_LObj list, delegating each light and current descriptor to the single-LObj attachment routine.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjAddCurrent
subjects.behavior: Registers a nullable light in current_lights, removing an existing registration first, retaining it, and inserting by the low eight bits of its stored u16 priority.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjAnim
subjects.behavior: Evaluates one animation step for an HSD light object by interpreting its light-property AObj through LObjUpdateFunc and then advancing the independently attached position and interest WObj animations.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjAnimAll
subjects.behavior: Advances one animation step for every light object in a next-linked HSD_LObj list. Each node evaluates its light-property animation controller and then advances the animations of its position and interest world objects.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjClearFlags
subjects.behavior: Disables caller-selected state or rendering options on a light object through a null-safe generic flag mutator, while preserving every unselected HSD_LObj flag.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjDeleteCurrent
subjects.behavior: Unregisters one HSD_LObj from the current-light registry. If registered, it invalidates every active light slot pointing to the object, frees its current-list node, and relinquishes the reference held by the registry.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjDeleteCurrentAll
subjects.behavior: Unregisters light objects from the renderer's current-light set: a non-NULL argument removes every LObj in the supplied linked chain, while NULL clears the entire current and active light state.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetActiveByID
subjects.behavior: Converts a GX light ID and returns the borrowed active-slot pointer, possibly NULL. Valid IDs are GX_LIGHT0..GX_LIGHT7 and GX_MAX_LIGHT for ambient; other IDs enter the converter assertion path.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetActiveByIndex
subjects.behavior: Retrieves a non-ambient active HSD light object by sequential active-slot index, allowing rendering code to iterate active infinite, point, and spot lights while excluding the separately reserved ambient slot.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetColor
subjects.behavior: Retrieves the color currently stored on an HSD light object and returns it through caller-provided output storage.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetCurrentByType
subjects.behavior: Returns the first light object in the current HSD light list whose light type matches the requested type.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetFlags
subjects.behavior: Provides null-safe read access to a light object's complete stored flag field so callers can inspect the HSD_LObj's configured modes and status bits without directly dereferencing a possibly null pointer.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetInterest
subjects.behavior: Retrieves a light object's effective interest point into a caller-provided vector when the LObj has an interest WObj, allowing callers to obtain the spatial point toward which the light is aimed.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetInterestWObj
subjects.behavior: Provides null-safe access to the world object that backs an HSD light object's interest point, allowing callers to work with the light's target object rather than only copying out its current coordinates.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetLightMaskAlpha
subjects.behavior: Returns the aggregate GX light-ID mask for active diffuse light objects that are enabled to affect the alpha lighting channel, allowing render-channel setup to select the lights used for alpha illumination.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetLightMaskAttnFunc
subjects.behavior: Returns the current attenuation-function light mask so rendering code can determine whether the active diffuse-light set contains a point or spot light and enable GX spot-style attenuation for the color channel when needed.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetLightMaskDiffuse
subjects.behavior: Returns the currently prepared set of GX light IDs that participate in diffuse lighting, allowing other rendering subsystems to use the same active diffuse-light selection without traversing the HSD light-object list again.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetLightMaskSpecular
subjects.behavior: Returns the aggregate GX light-ID mask assigned to specular light objects during the current light-setup pass so render-state setup can enable those lights on the specular color channel.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetLightVector
subjects.behavior: Computes a light object's normalized direction vector from its position toward its interest point and writes that unit vector to caller-provided storage.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetNbActive
subjects.behavior: Returns the nonambient slot-assignment counter since the last active-table clear. Deleting a current light can leave NULL holes without reducing this counter, so it is not always the number of populated entries.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetPosition
subjects.behavior: Conditionally retrieves an HSD light object's effective position into a caller-provided vector by delegating resolution of the light's position HSD_WObj.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjGetPositionWObj
subjects.behavior: Provides null-safe access to the world-object reference that stores an HSD light object's position, allowing animation and lighting code to work with the position WObj without directly dereferencing a possibly null HSD_LObj.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjLoadDesc
subjects.behavior: Loads a descriptor chain in order, allocating each light from its registered named class when found, otherwise through HSD_LObjAlloc using the configured default class or base hsdLObj. Returns NULL for an empty descriptor chain.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjRemoveAll
subjects.behavior: Releases an entire next-linked chain of HSD_LObj instances, first detaching each object from the current and active light registries and then relinquishing an additional reference to that object.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjReqAnimAll
subjects.behavior: Requests that every light in a linked HSD_LObj list begin or resume all of its attached animations from one supplied frame.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetColor
subjects.behavior: Sets the stored color of an HSD light object so subsequent light setup or rendering can use the new color.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetCurrentAll
subjects.behavior: Replaces the complete current-light registry with one supplied HSD_LObj, or clears the registry when passed NULL, so a subsequent light-setup pass begins from a new lighting context.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetDistAttn
subjects.signature: void HSD_LObjSetDistAttn(HSD_LObj* lobj, f32 ref_dist, f32 ref_br,                          s32 dist_func)
subjects.behavior: Configures the reference distance, reference brightness, and distance-attenuation function that a point or spot HSD light will use when its GX light objects are initialized.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetFlags
subjects.behavior: Null-safely enables one or more state bits on an HSD light object without clearing any flags already present.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetInterest
subjects.behavior: Sets an HSD light object's three-dimensional point of interest, lazily creating the backing HSD_WObj when necessary. That point acts with the light's position as the endpoint used to derive the light's normalized direction.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetPosition
subjects.behavior: Sets an HSD light object's three-dimensional source position, creating the associated position WObj on first use so callers can position even an LObj that does not yet have spatial storage.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetSpot
subjects.signature: void HSD_LObjSetSpot(HSD_LObj* lobj, f32 cutoff, s32 point_func)
subjects.behavior: Configures the angular cone of an HSD spotlight by storing its cutoff angle and GX spotlight falloff function for use when the light's GXLightObj is next prepared.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetup
subjects.signature: void HSD_LObjSetup(HSD_LObj* lobj, GXColor color, f32 shininess)
subjects.behavior: Synchronizes one active HSD light's draw-dependent diffuse color and specular shininess state with its assigned GX hardware light slots, avoiding redundant initialization and upload when the cached values are unchanged.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetupInit
subjects.behavior: Rebuilds draw-time lighting state for a camera: it clears the previous active-light selection and light masks, chooses eligible current HSD light objects, prepares their camera-space geometry and diffuse or specular roles, allocates secondary specular light IDs where needed, and installs the resulting active lights into GX.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObjSetupSpecularInit
subjects.behavior: Recomputes the direction of every active specular GX light for the object currently being displayed, deriving a normalized half-vector from the object's position-matrix translation and each eligible light's view-space position or direction, then marking the resulting specular light object for reloading.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LObj_803668EC
subjects.behavior: Replaces the renderer's complete current-light registry with every HSD_LObj in a supplied next-linked chain, allowing subsequent light setup to build a new lighting context from that chain.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:HSD_LightID2Index
subjects.behavior: Converts a GX light identifier into its contiguous zero-based HSD light-slot index: GX_LIGHT0 through GX_LIGHT7 become indices 0 through 7, and the GX_MAX_LIGHT sentinel becomes 8.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:LObjAmnesia
subjects.behavior: Handles HSD class-amnesia notifications for the light-object subsystem by invalidating LObj module references associated with the forgotten class and then propagating the notification to the parent HSD object class.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:LObjInfoInit
subjects.behavior: Bootstraps the HSD_LObj runtime class as a subclass of HSD_Obj and installs the light object's release, class-amnesia, and descriptor-loading methods for HSD class dispatch.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:LObjLoad
subjects.signature: static int LObjLoad(HSD_LObj* lobj, HSD_LightDesc* ldesc)
subjects.behavior: Populates an existing HSD_LObj from one HSD_LightDesc, installing common light properties and dispatching by light type to construct the required spatial objects and attenuation configuration.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:LObjRelease
subjects.behavior: Implements the HSD_LObj class's release-stage cleanup: it removes the light object's animation object, relinquishes its position and interest WObj references, and then delegates remaining base-object cleanup to the parent HSD object class.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:LObjUpdateFunc
subjects.signature: void LObjUpdateFunc(void* obj, enum_t type, HSD_ObjData* val)
subjects.behavior: Acts as the per-track animation update callback for an HSD light object, dispatching each light-animation attribute to the corresponding visibility, attenuation, spotlight, or color property.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:setup_point_lightobj
subjects.signature: static void setup_point_lightobj(HSD_LObj* lobj, Mtx mtx)
subjects.behavior: Prepares an HSD point light's embedded diffuse and specular GX light objects by installing its color, matrix-transformed position, and distance-attenuation state for subsequent GX loading.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:setup_spec_lightobj
subjects.signature: static void setup_spec_lightobj(HSD_LObj* lobj, Mtx mtx, s32 spec_id)
subjects.behavior: Prepares an HSD light object's embedded secondary GX light object for specular lighting and registers its assigned GX light ID in the frame's specular-light mask.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj:setup_spot_lightobj
subjects.signature: static void setup_spot_lightobj(HSD_LObj* lobj, Mtx mtx)
subjects.behavior: Prepares an HSD spotlight's primary and companion specular GX light objects for rendering by transforming its position and direction into camera view space and configuring the primary light's angular and distance attenuation.
subjects.naming_decision: retain canonical unless explicit proposal or disposition says otherwise
